$comment: Phase plan for the Metro to Rust port, read by gate.sh. Agents may not edit 'baselineRef', 'perf' or anything under port/approvals/. Targets are speedups versus pure-JS Metro at baselineRef (2.0 = twice as fast), cumulative over phases. They are first proposals and Szymon may change them.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.exit: An empty Rust crate loads from Metro through napi-rs; METRO_RUST and the unstable_rust config switch exist; the differential check is green JS vs JS.

phases.title: Pure leaf libraries
phases.exit: All metro-source-map tests pass with the Rust binding; differential bundles produce byte-identical .map files.

phases.title: Resolver
phases.exit: Every resolver test and every case in port/blackbox/fixtures/resolver.json passes against Rust.

perf.$comment: End-to-end time may get worse while file lookups still cross into JS. The resolver goes live together with the Rust file map in phase 3.

phases.title: File map and resolution glue
phases.exit: Black-box file-map suite passes with the Node crawler and with Watchman; differential bundles identical.

phases.title: Incremental graph
phases.exit: Graph, incremental-rebuild and HMR suites pass on both sides; HMR deltas identical across a scripted edit session; transform-cache and worker-farm suites pass on both sides.
phases.$comment: Scope widened by Szymon on 2026-10-14 after the phase 4 profile (graph plus resolution is about 440 of 2190 ms of a warm build): Rust reads the transform cache (metro-cache FileStore entries) and the worker farm starts on the first cache miss. The edit target moved to phase 5, which owns most of an edit.

phases.title: Output and server
phases.exit: Server endpoint, CLI and output suites pass on both sides; byte-identical output on the differential apps; the JS fallback still works.

phases.title: Rust transform pass (optional)
phases.exit: Snapshot parity for transform-plugin and collectDependencies tests; differential bundles identical with Terser.
